name: Blog Grid
description: A responsive blog post grid where each card pairs a cover image, category tag, title, excerpt, and author-and-date meta into a clean, scannable archive.
usage: React: import BlogGrid from './BlogGrid'; then <BlogGrid /> (override eyebrow, heading, intro, posts, and ariaLabel to customize). HTML: copy the <section> from section.html into any Tailwind page. Both use the Sand & Surf palette; open preview.html in a browser to see the section rendered standalone via the Tailwind Play CDN.
